name: @nexus/release-infra
description: EP-042 M3 release transport infrastructure (SPEC-016, SPEC-024): real SigV4 S3 transport over Web Crypto + global fetch, digest-bound publish/fetch of release manifests and component artifacts against a real S3-compatible object store (SeaweedFS), readiness probe, timeout/cancellation, idempotent publish, current-run redacted audit events, and fail-closed config validation. Canonical release truth remains in crates/nexus-release (M1) and apps/setup/src/update/ (M2); this package is the transport boundary only.
